_comment: Your clinic's details. This file is a REFERENCE COPY, not something the workflow reads.
n8n cannot load a local file at runtime, so the live values live inside the workflow, in
the 'Prepare Conversation State' node. Keep this file in sync as your written record of
what you set, and see docs/SOP_CUSTOMIZE.md for how to apply it.
Copy this to config/clinic.json (gitignored) before filling in real details.
clinic_hours_text: Monday to Saturday, 8AM to 5PM, closed Sunday

_field_notes.clinic_timezone: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Manila, America/New_York, Europe/London. It must also be changed everywhere else in the workflow, see docs/SOP_CUSTOMIZE.md. npm test checks they agree.
_field_notes.clinic_open_hour: 24h clock. 8 = 8AM. The first hour an appointment may start.
_field_notes.clinic_close_hour: 24h clock. 17 = 5PM. Every appointment must END by this hour.
_field_notes.clinic_closed_weekdays: ISO weekday numbers, 1 = Monday through 7 = Sunday. [7] closes Sunday, [6,7] closes the weekend, [] never closes.
_field_notes.clinic_hours_text: Shown to patients verbatim. Must agree with the three fields above, nothing checks this for you.
_field_notes.clinic_last_walk_in: Text only. Shown to patients who ask about walk-ins.
